verdict.rationale: llamafile ships whisperfile, a first-party on-device speech-to-text tool built on whisper.cpp, and the product runs fully offline. However, the evidence only documents transcription of audio files, not live dictation or real-time streaming from a microphone. Missing for 10: documented real-time/streaming microphone transcription, dictation UX, latency evidence, hands-on corroboration of whisperfile.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model

citations.quote: llamafile also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool built on whisper.cpp and the same Cosmopolitan packaging. It supports transcription and translation of audio files across all the same platforms, with no installation required.
Models run entirely on your device. No cloud, no data sharing, no external dependencies.
